title: The plural heading 'Methods' was not recognised, silently disabling the methodology-fabrication check

found.context: Stage B mocked test of integrity_check.py (T-087)

observed_failure: METHOD_SECTION_RE matched 'method' with word boundaries, so 'Methods' never matched; M6 and the methods-critical alignment tier did nothing on almost any real paper, and a clean report looked like a pass.
expected_behavior: Method-section detection matches the plural and common variants (Methods, Methodology, Experimental setup, Materials).

resolution.summary: the pattern covers plurals and common headings

lessons: A check that finds nothing must be tested with a planted defect, or silence looks like success.
